chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The wife of Noah (peace be upon him) came while he was building the ship, and she said to him, 'Water is flowing out from the oven.' He hurried to it, placed the lid over it, and sealed it with his seal. The water stopped. When he finished from the ship, he went to the seal, broke it, and uncovered the lid, and the water gushed forth.
ai.seo_question: What happened when Noah's wife saw water coming from the oven during the construction of the ship?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the practical preparation of Noah (peace be upon him) for the flood, specifically focusing on the sealing of the *tanur* (oven) to prevent water ingress during construction. In Shia exegesis, this event is often linked to the divine command to build the ark in secret and serves as a precursor to the flood's onset, illustrating both the physical reality of the miracle and the obedience of the Prophet to Allah's specific instructions regarding the preservation of the vessel.
